# secobserve_branch (Data Source)

Looks up a branch by product and exact name. Branch names are unique per product, so both are required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Branch names are unique per product, so both are required.
data "secobserve_branch" "main" {
  product = data.secobserve_product.checkout.id
  name    = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the branch. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, even though SecObserve's own filter is a substring match.
- `product` (Number) Id of the product the branch belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `cpe23` (String) CPE 2.3 name identifying the branch.
- `housekeeping_protect` (Boolean) Whether the branch is exempt from housekeeping.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the branch.
- `is_default_branch` (Boolean) Whether this is the product's default branch.
- `last_import` (String) When observations were last imported for this branch.
- `name_with_product` (String) Branch name qualified with its product.
- `osv_linux_distribution` (String) Linux distribution used when matching OSV advisories.
- `osv_linux_release` (String) Release of the Linux distribution.
- `purl` (String) Package URL identifying the branch.
